scope: Controlled native-terminal reanalysis on immutable completed relative-parent source rollouts; source/native prefix and label effects, not a new game generator or already stronger actor.
limitations: All288source games, including the32predeclared selection games, undergo the same frozen transform before fitting. The preceding diagnostic used TRAIN only.
